title: Numeral frame-expand hero (Springs)
source: springs.estate nature hero. Engine = library/components/numeral-frame-expand-hero (proven, set(p), owns_pin).
engine: Giant outline numerals with a small framed view inside; on scroll the frame expands to full-bleed, numerals fade, a serif title rises, a parallax pan, then exit-rise — one continuous pinned scroll-narrative. Pure set(p) across the whole story.
differs: Same narrative + same set(p). TRIGGER differs: desktop scrubs set(p) from scroll while the hero pins (full narrative incl. exit); mobile plays set(p) 0->restAt once over time on mount, resting at the resolved frame (no exit). Springs mobile plays the hero on load; desktop scrubs the full story.

desktop.driver: scrollHero — set(p) = scroll progress across the pin span (full 0..1 incl. exit).

mobile.driver: autoHero — set(p) plays 0->restAt once over playMs on mount, then rests.

engine_patch: forceMotion + manualDrive (expose set() without engine pin/ScrollTrigger; guard registerPlugin/ticker/lenis). Additive & opt-in.
entry: NumeralFrameExpandHeroDual.init(target, opts). Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .nfe-hero > .nfe-bg(.nfe-frame>img) + .nfe-numerals + .nfe-title + .nfe-sub. Desktop wraps in .pin-wrap.
law: set(p) PURE; clip-path inset + transform (scale/translateY) + opacity only; GPU; NO WebGL. reduced-motion -> resolved frame + title (no exit).
